name: How does Hometelligent Inc. approach structural engineering coordination?

mainEntity.name: How does Hometelligent Inc. approach structural engineering coordination?

acceptedAnswer.text: Hometelligent Inc. integrates structural engineering coordination as a core part of our design-build process, utilizing a collaborative approach. We facilitate regular meetings and digital model sharing (BIM) among our in-house structural engineers, architects, and other trade professionals from areas like Fremont to San Leandro. This first-party insight ensures all disciplines are aligned, potential issues are resolved proactively, and designs meet both safety standards and aesthetic goals.
acceptedAnswer.description: Hometelligent uses a collaborative design-build approach with regular meetings and BIM to align engineers, architects, and trades.
